entry.title: Vibecoded GTA 6 PC Ports Are Now Rendering In-Game Graphics Despite Take-Two Crackdown
entry.summary: Some unofficial ports now hit around 20 frames per second, as developers move their work into private communities to dodge takedowns.

entry.title: What Is Self-Custody? How to Hold Your Own Crypto Keys
entry.summary: Self-custody means holding your own crypto instead of trusting an exchange. Here's how it works, the wallets involved and the risks.

entry.title: Before the Sell-Off, AI Stocks Showed Dot-Com-Level Bubble Signals: Study
entry.summary: A study of 170 years of financial journalism suggests AI stocks rivaled dot-com bubble levels, but estimates vary.

entry.title: Bitcoin Holds Above $60K as Death Cross Clouds Thanksgiving Recovery
entry.summary: Bitcoin and major altcoins rose slightly on Thanksgiving, but a bearish death cross suggests crypto remains weaker than stocks.

entry.title: Spain Lets Its Financial Intelligence Unit Freeze Crypto Accounts Without a Court Order
entry.summary: Sepblac can now suspend crypto, bank and payment accounts for up to five working days, with courts deciding on any extension.

entry.title: OpenAI Fixes ChatGPT Billing Error, Promises to Make it 40% Worse
entry.summary: OpenAI says a billing mistake made its new AI models cheaper to use than intended. Subscribers will now burn through their allowances faster, but get a free one-time usage reset.

entry.title: Elon Musk Says ‘Multiplanetary’ SpaceX Could Be Worth $118 Quintillion. Yes, Quintillion
entry.summary: The SpaceX founder claims the firm could one day be worth a million times the global economy, as he pledges free shares to American children.

entry.title: Cournot Raises $5M to Build AI-Native Oracle for Verifiable Intelligence
entry.summary: The startup uses AI to interpret real-world events for onchain apps and agents, recording evidence and reasoning so outcomes can be audited.

entry.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody Says Hackers Accessed Client Contact Details
entry.summary: The crypto custodian said an unauthorized party accessed some client and staff names and emails, but found no unauthorized transactions.

entry.title: Galaxy Research Withdraws Call That Bitcoin's Bear Market Is Over
entry.summary: A month after saying Bitcoin had bottomed in June, Galaxy now says a daily close below $58,525 would signal a materially lower low.

entry.title: UK Regulator Cites Binance Hack as It Plans Tougher DeFi Rules Than US and EU: Report
entry.summary: The FCA plans to require DeFi platforms to be authorized and to keep regulated exchanges from routing UK retail trades to them.

entry.title: New York Wins $1.37B Judgment Against NovaTech Founders Who Fled the US
entry.summary: The couple fled the U.S. before a default ruling in 2025, so victims of the scheme may struggle to recover their money.

entry.title: China's Google Just Released Its Fast New AI Model for Free
entry.summary: Baidu has released the weights of its new high-speed reasoning model, giving developers a commercially usable alternative to proprietary AI services from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic

entry.title: What Happened to Alice Huang, the Woman at the Center of Nvidia’s Scandal?
entry.summary: U.S. intelligence found no evidence that Beijing directed Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia’s CEO, but the former Megaspeed executive still faces entry bans and scrutiny of business ties.

entry.title: The 1Password Breach Didn’t Touch Your Vault. The Phishing Emails Might
entry.summary: An attacker compromised an employee’s GitHub account to reach 1Password’s backend and copy customer names and emails, but the company says vault contents, encryption keys and your Secret Key were never exposed.

entry.title: Another Bitcoin Mining Firm Flags 'Hashrate Hijacking' Attacks That Reroute Rewards
entry.summary: Braiins says an attacker exploited the unencrypted Stratum V1 protocol and internet route hijacking to impersonate mining pools, striking over 1,000 sites in a single second.

entry.title: What Is Artex? The AI Hacking Tool Linked to the US Spy Agency Breach
entry.summary: Microsoft says state-backed hackers and cybercriminals are using Artex to automate attacks with AI agents, exploiting familiar security flaws at speeds that leave defenders little time to respond or recover.

entry.title: Nvidia to Pay $290 Million to Settle Long-Running Crypto Mining Revenue Lawsuit
entry.summary: The proposed cash settlement would resolve a shareholder suit alleging the chipmaker hid how much of its 2017-2018 gaming revenue came from crypto miners.

entry.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX Gets FCC Approval to Launch AI Data Centers in Space
entry.summary: The FCC authorized SpaceX’s solar-powered Starmind constellation, backing Elon Musk’s plans to move AI computing into orbit and reduce the industry’s dependence on increasingly strained power grids here on Earth.

entry.title: OpenAI’s Changes to ChatGPT Could Drastically Cut Usage Limits for Paying Subscribers
entry.summary: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work modes, forcing advanced conversations to compete with coding tasks for usage and leaving paying subscribers wondering how much AI they will actually get.

entry.title: Elon Musk’s X Wins Court Judgment Against Alleged Bitcoin Bot Farm Operators
entry.summary: London’s High Court entered a default judgment against Vivek Kumar Sen and Zamyang Sherpa after they failed to respond, though damages, which X estimates at over £207,000, won’t be set until a later hearing.

entry.title: Bitcoin Falls Further as Inflation, Trump Tariffs and AI Selloff Rattle Markets
entry.summary: Bitcoin fell below $58,000 as stronger U.S. growth, accelerating inflation and proposed tariffs coincided with a renewed AI stock selloff and bets on higher interest rates in December and beyond.

entry.title: Ukraine Passes Law to Legalize and Tax Its Crypto Market From July 2027
entry.summary: The law taxes crypto profits at 18% plus a 5% military levy, cuts the rate for older holdings and puts stablecoins under the central bank.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Ethereum Focuses on Security As AI Threats Rise
entry.summary: The Ethereum Foundation pulls its quantum-resistance deadline forward to end 2028, as AI labs say their next models are too dangerous.

entry.title: French Senate Rejects Plan to Make Crypto Holders Declare Self-Custody Wallets
entry.summary: Holders had warned that reporting wallets worth over €100,000 could expose them to risk in a country hit by a wave of crypto kidnappings.

entry.title: Florida Man Jailed for Using AI to Pose as Streamer N3ON in $260K Crypto Scam
entry.summary: David Anthony Sanchez posed as the streamer to persuade a meme coin project's organizers to pay him for a fake endorsement deal.

entry.title: Hyperliquid Leads Altcoin Losses as Bitcoin Slips Below $59K
entry.summary: HYPE fell more than 8% after Abraxas Capital pulled out of Hyperliquid, while U.S. Bitcoin ETFs' November outflows passed $4.9 billion.

entry.title: Take-Two Hits GTA 6 PC Port Leonida With DMCA, Taking Down 3,007 GitHub Repos
entry.summary: Rockstar's parent said the project's "bring your own files" instruction was a misleading attempt to dodge responsibility for the leak.

entry.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Insiders Fear Their Next AI Models Are Too Dangerous to Release
entry.summary: Employees at both AI labs reportedly question whether their strongest models should ever reach the public, as researchers struggle to keep increasingly capable systems under control during training and testing.

entry.title: Anthropic’s Claude Ship Lets AI Write, Review and Approve Its Own Code
entry.summary: Anthropic’s new coding tools can review and repair software changes before approving them for release, leaving development teams to decide when a human still needs to check the AI’s work.

entry.title: Coldcard Bitcoin Exploit, Revisited: How a Hidden Flaw Survived Years of Audits
entry.summary: Coinkite’s postmortem reveals a software random-number generator shipped in place of the hardware one for over five years, slipping past at least 15 reviews.

entry.title: Ethereum Foundation Says AI Is a More Urgent Threat Than Quantum Computing
entry.summary: The Ethereum Foundation has doubled its protocol security team and is prioritizing a cryptographic overhaul as advances in AI threaten the mathematical assumptions that keep billions in crypto safe.

entry.title: Bitcoin Losses Are the Worst Since FTX. Is the Bottom Near?
entry.summary: Bitcoin slipped below $60,000 as realized losses nearly doubled in a week. Glassnode says the sell-off resembles past market bottoms, but another drop to $53,200 could be in the cards.

entry.title: What the CFTC’s New Crypto Reserves Guidance Actually Allows—And What It Doesn’t
entry.summary: Staff guidance lets swap venues and clearinghouses count Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins toward their 12-month operating-cost buffer. Here's the catch.

entry.title: South Korea Moves to Lift Its ICO Ban After Nearly a Decade
entry.summary: The Financial Services Commission’s draft Digital Asset Act would let domestic projects sell tokens again under IPO-style disclosure rules, reversing a 2017 ban that mostly pushed Korean issuers offshore.
